question: ________ include/s glycogen, poly-β- hydroxybutyrate granules, sulphur granules and gas vesicles.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Cytoplasm.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Cytoplasm **include/s glycogen, poly-β- hydroxybutyrate granules, sulphur granules and gas vesicles.
 
• The cytoplasm consists of material outside the nucleus in the cell.
 
• It consists of the **cytoskeleton, ribosomes, and centrosome.**
 
• The cytoplasm is a gelatin-like, semi-transparent fluid.
 
• It contains organelles such as mitochondrion, Golgi apparatus, vacuoles, plastids, cell wall, and the endoplasmic reticulum.
